$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFTP (AIP France, chart dated 2022-04-21): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Puimoisson

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for home-based ACFT.
If northern wind is higher than 20 kt use of RWY 07/25 is prohibited.
RWY 16/34 usable only by seasonal or permanent home based ACFT in accordance with local instructions decided by the CAA.
Simultaneous movements on both RWY 07 and 25 prohibited.
Landing of powered ACFT on QFU 074°, with West sector wind lower than 15 kt, authorized considering sloping ground.
TWY width: 30 m TWY A along the runway, and TWY B 22 m when joining the hangar, 45 m TWY C SouthEast of the RWY.
Fire extinguisher located close to the refuelling area.
QFU 338°: In mistral wind conditions, highly turbulent aerology due to a ravine ahead of THR 34.
Taxiing outside runway possible.
Caution for LDG RWY 25 (3.5% declivity).
AD réservé aux ACFT basés.
Utilisation RWY 07/25 interdite par vent de secteur Nord supérieur à 20 kt.
RWY 16/34 utilisable uniquement par les usagers basés de façon permanente ou saisonnière conformément aux consignes locales établies par la CAA.
Mouvements simultanés sur RWY 07 et 25 interdits.
Atterrissage des ACFT motopropulsés en QFU 074° autorisé par vent d'Ouest inférieur à 15 kt compte tenu de la déclivité du terrain.
Largeur des TWY : 30 m TWY A le long de la piste, et TWY B 22 m pour rejoindre le hangar, 45 m TWY C au Sud-Est de la piste.
Extincteur situé à proximité de l'aire d'avitaillement.
QFU 338° : Aérologie fortement pertubée à l'ATT par mistral dû à la présence d'un ravin en amont du THR 34.
Roulage hors-piste autorisé.
Précautions pour ATT RWY 25 (déclivité 3.5 %).
